color.note: Dark first. Warm charcoal neutrals, one ember accent, status hues that never ride on hue alone. Each text token names the grounds it is checked on, in both themes.

tokens.name: ember-50
tokens.usage: Ramp step, palest glow. Sequential fills nearest zero in the light theme; never text.

tokens.name: ember-100
tokens.usage: Ramp step. The light theme’s ember-soft.

tokens.name: ember-200
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Sequential and ordinal fills; never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: ember-300
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Light end of the dark theme’s ordinal ramp.

tokens.name: ember-400
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Dark theme ember-text, ember-hover and focus color; light end of the light theme’s ordinal ramp.

tokens.name: ember-500
tokens.usage: The brand ember. Dark theme primary fill and the cover’s lead block.

tokens.name: ember-600
tokens.usage: Light theme primary fill (white label 4.6:1) and light theme focus color.

tokens.name: ember-700
tokens.usage: Light theme ember-text and ember-hover.

tokens.name: ember-800
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Dark end of ordinal and sequential ramps (dark theme ordinal ramp starts here).

tokens.name: ember-900
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Dark end of the light theme’s sequential ramp.

tokens.name: ember-950
tokens.usage: Ramp step, a banked coal. The dark theme’s ember-soft.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas: page background, the side nav and the gutters between cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The working plane: cards, panels, table bodies, the top bar. Chart colors are validated on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers (menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs) and the secondary button fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: text fields, selects, code blocks and the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for table rows, nav items and ghost buttons on bg or surface.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Pressed and neutral-selected fill; progress and switch tracks; avatar ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and table borders, chart gridlines, secondary button edge. Decorative, never the only boundary of a field.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control: text field, select, checkbox and switch outlines; chart baselines. At least 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, surface-hover and surface-active (12.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (descriptions, table headers, inactive tabs and nav labels) on every surface, surface-active included (5.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (placeholders, timestamps, axis labels, captions) on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-hover (4.6:1 or more). Not on surface-active.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only. Deliberately under 4.5:1; WCAG exempts disabled controls.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The one accent fill: primary button, checked checkbox, switch on, progress fill, selected markers. Label it with on-ember. At most one ember-filled action per view.

tokens.name: ember-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of an ember fill: lighter in the dark theme, deeper in the light. Still labelled with on-ember.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ember and ember-hover (4.6:1 or more): near-black in the dark theme, white in the light.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Ember as text or icon (active nav icon, selected value, eyebrow accent) on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-hover and ember-soft (5.3:1 or more). Links stay ink with an ember underline.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ember-text: active nav item, ember badge, selected row marker.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus color, used through the focus-ring shadow. 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy, complete, up-is-good deltas: text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and success-soft (4.9:1 or more). Teal, off the red–green axis; always beside an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Degraded or needs attention: text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and warning-soft (4.7:1 or more). Always with the triangle icon or a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, invalid, destructive, down-is-bad deltas: text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and danger-soft (5.3:1 or more). It sits near ember in hue, so it always carries the alert icon or a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges, alerts and field errors.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive button (Delete, Revoke). Never placed beside an ember primary.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger-solid (5:1 or more).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, tips and doc links: text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and info-soft (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series slot 1 (ember). The lead series; sparkline current-period accent. Assign slots in order, never cycled; marks only, labels stay in ink tokens. Validated on surface in both themes (CVD and normal-vision separation, 3:1).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series slot 2 (teal). Assign slots in order, never cycled; marks only, labels stay in ink tokens. Validated on surface in both themes (CVD and normal-vision separation, 3:1).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series slot 3 (violet). Assign slots in order, never cycled; marks only, labels stay in ink tokens. Validated on surface in both themes (CVD and normal-vision separation, 3:1).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series slot 4 (gold). Assign slots in order, never cycled; marks only, labels stay in ink tokens. Validated on surface in both themes (CVD and normal-vision separation, 3:1).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series slot 5 (blue). Assign slots in order, never cycled; marks only, labels stay in ink tokens. Validated on surface in both themes (CVD and normal-vision separation, 3:1).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Series slot 6 (magenta). Past six series, fold the rest into Other. Assign slots in order, never cycled; marks only, labels stay in ink tokens. Validated on surface in both themes (CVD and normal-vision separation, 3:1).

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, variable with optical sizing: it tightens on its own as it grows. Titles only, never body copy or numbers.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Empty states, onboarding and first-run screens. One per view, if any.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans carries the interface. Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: text-subtitle
styles.usage: Card titles and table group headings.

styles.name: text-body-lg
styles.sample: Runs pause on their own when a source stops responding, and pick up again when it recovers.
styles.usage: Reading text: dialog bodies, empty-state descriptions, docs.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Last synced 4 minutes ago from the warehouse.
styles.usage: Default interface text, table cells, field values.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, tabs, nav items, table headers.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Help text, timestamps, metadata, chart axis labels.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Figures stay in the interface sans at semibold with proportional digits; columns that must align add tabular-nums.

styles.name: text-metric-lg
styles.usage: The hero figure a dashboard leads with. Exactly one per view.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything a person might copy: IDs, hashes, code, log lines, keys.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: Code, IDs, hashes, log lines, keyboard keys.

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines above a group or a metric; set the caps with text-transform.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the steps; never in-between values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges; checkbox-to-label nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and nav items; gap between stacked chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small controls; label-to-field gap; table cell inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and fields; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; space above a page title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on first-run and marketing-adjacent screens.

radius.note: Soft rectangles; pills only for badges, switches, avatars and progress.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tooltips, keyboard keys, tags inside table cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, nav items, segmented-control segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, selects, alerts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, switches, avatars, progress bars.

shadow.note: Borders separate in the dark theme; shadows are reserved for things that float. Glow is the ember accent’s light and belongs to the primary action only.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: One-pixel top light on raised controls (primary and secondary buttons, selected segment).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Ember glow on the primary button’s hover. Nothing else glows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page color, then 2px of solid focus color. Drawn as a shadow so it follows the radius; 3:1 or more on every surface.

size.note: Fixed dimensions shared by controls and layout.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons, fields and segmented controls (dense tables, toolbars).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, fields and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons on empty states and touch-first screens.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, badges, fields and table cells.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Nav icons, alert and toast icons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty-state and standalone icons.

tokens.name: sidenav-width
tokens.usage: Width of the expanded side navigation.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content beside the side nav.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the top bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and popovers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a dialog.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The toast stack.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, above everything.
